main_text.p: bus Judæx, & unius populi, sed splendet ad usum omnium gentium: 6. Quia ad fidei obedientiam tendit, id est, ut audientes, adducti ad fidem Christi, reddantur obedientes subditi regni Gratiæ ejus: simul Deo gloriam horum omnium tribuit ut soli, in se, & à se sapienti, qui nulli-sapientiam suam debet: Ipsi per Christum sit gloria in secula seculorum. AMEN.

page.notes: The ornament band at the foot is a printer's decoration, not transcribed. Small capitals rendered in italics where the original uses small capitals (CHRISTI, CHRISTUM, AMEN).
